# AutoFactory

> Get 3D models manufactured through an agent-friendly API. Upload models,
> choose materials and quantities, get a quote, and send the buyer a checkout link.

Agents handle quoting and order updates. The buyer completes hosted checkout.
Only AutoFactory operators can activate new API keys. The API reports current
materials, limits, prices and order state.

## Agent skill

- [AutoFactory skill repository](https://github.com/autofactory-build/autofactory-skill): Installation, instructions and API task references.
